performance_case.causal_mechanism: A point-in-time D-1 expiry-futures inventory plus complete confirmed D-day futures and index raw atoms can test whether lagged fixed-maturity crypto carry contains independent admission information without same-day leakage.
performance_case.claim_boundary: This slice proves only an offline disabled source contract, strict raw-atom schemas and deterministic validation. It cannot prove endpoint availability, predictive value, fees, slippage, matched-capital PnL, drawdown improvement, candidate readiness, deployment, OOS or Trading authority.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: Immediate drawdown effect is zero. Any future reduction in adverse DRA entry path or maximum drawdown remains MISSING_PROOF until a preregistered matched-capital experiment passes Validation and sealed OOS.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: Without this slice, carry research either remains blocked or risks using after-the-fact instrument selection and leaking D+1 information. A false-positive contract could waste implementation and future evidence time, so incomplete inventory, clock drift and source ambiguity must fail closed.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: The contract cannot improve fee-adjusted total PnL directly, but it reduces time to a credible accept-or-reject test of one primary-supported carry mechanism while preventing duplicate funding work, backfill and outcome-driven source selection.
